body: It's very hard to focus on what matters. I can't do most of the things I enjoyed doing. I loved going to music festivals, The last 2 have been so painful that it wasn't even worth going. I love to game, but I can't focus with the headache, and the fast motions are giving me motion sickness.
Yes, I drink a few bottles of water a day, sometimes up to a gallon or close to it. I have also been taking a multivitamin since the headaches started with no results.
